title: Cincinnati Observatory National Historic Landmark registration, section7pages4–6
usage: Architectural text facts only; no document photographs/scans/plans copied or used.

facts.Herget: 1873brick/limestone building; raised ashlar basement. Three-bay portico has outer stone piers and inner fluted Doric columns, triangular pediment/ball/oculus. Tall6/6sash, west-wing altered narrow windows, continuous sillband, castiron roof balustrade/paired chimneys; silver ribbed1895dome on square support.
facts.Mitchel: Southeast1904/1908brick building; five-bay west front. Taller downslope rear has central domed turret and smaller northeast cone turret. Two-column entrance with low pediment/elliptical transom; ashlarbase, stone water table, dentilled cornice/coping, brick quoins/keystones. South three windows infilled.

operatorSources.fact: Two buildings; main Herget1873with1895dome; Mitchel1904with two distinct dome/cap structures.
Herget renovation beganJuly2026; permanent exterior based on2019reference, temporary works excluded.
